guideImpact.affectedSection: GIS Display Settings: Show linked sites
guideImpact.reason: The delivered behavior adds a visible Show linked sites checkbox in Surveyor layer Display Settings, including how to change it and verify that the selected state is retained when the settings are reopened.

guideUpdate.title: Manage linked-site visibility in a Surveyor layer
guideUpdate.affectedSection: GIS Display Settings: Show linked sites
steps: Open Display Settings for a loaded Surveyor layer.
Note whether Show linked sites is checked or unchecked.
Select Show linked sites to switch its state.
Close and reopen Display Settings to confirm the selected state remains visible.
Select Show linked sites again to restore the recorded initial state.
Close and reopen Display Settings to confirm the original state is restored.
screenshotCaptions: Display Settings shows Show linked sites checked for the loaded Surveyor layer.
After the setting is changed and Display Settings is reopened, Show linked sites remains unchecked.
After restoring the initial setting and reopening Display Settings, Show linked sites is checked again.
guideUpdate.reason: Update the Surveyor layer Display Settings guidance to describe changing Show linked sites and confirming the changed and restored states after reopening.
